title: M4Bench: Evaluating Procedural Specification for Clinical EHR Derivation Agents
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We introduce M4Bench, 28 clinical derivation tasks across 15 task families on MIMIC-IV and eICU, to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce such derivations and how clinician-reviewed agent skills change their results.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: In a Docker-isolated Codex campaign (GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5), skills raise reward by 0.136 over the no-skill baseline, with 26 of 28 tasks improving.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Schema obfuscation and restructuring preserve 86% and 70% of the skill gain (GPT 5.4 Mini, 26 MIMIC-IV tasks), a descriptive robustness check rather than a bound on memorization.
